messages:
zoe_fin: Heads-up: nightly-recon flagged 27 duplicate receipt records in NetSuite where the same Stripe charge appears to have two receipts. Customers are unaffected but ledger shows duplicates and AR aging off by $12,450. Sample Stripe charge: ch_3Kxyz.
sam: Can you paste an example webhook trace? My first guess: we might be using `payment_intent.id` as the idempotency key when creating receipts; with SCA flows Stripe sometimes creates a new PaymentIntent (or reuses and swaps `latest_charge`) and we end up creating a second receipt.
leah_ops: Here's an example chain for customer cust_ABC and invoice inv_02L:

```
// webhook sequence (times are roughly)
evt_101 payment_intent.created (pi_1: pi_123)
evt_102 payment_intent.succeeded (pi_1 -> charge ch_3Kxyz)
evt_103 payment_intent.created (pi_2: pi_123_auth) // new PI created for SCA
evt_104 payment_intent.succeeded (pi_2 -> charge ch_3Kxyz) // same charge id reused
```
Our consumer processed evt_102 and created receipt in NetSuite keyed by `payment_intent.id` (pi_123) and then processed evt_104 and created a second receipt keyed by `payment_intent.id` (pi_123_auth). Both map to the same `charge.id` and invoice.
max_fin: That explains duplicates. Dollar impact = $12,450 total, largest single customer delta $1,200. Finance can approve automated reversal/void of duplicate receipts for deltas <= $2,000. Anything above we'll handle case-by-case.
sam: Proposed fixes:
1) Change idempotency key for receipts to prefer `invoice.id` or `charge.id` when present (stronger canonical key). Fallback to payment_intent.id only if no invoice/charge present.
2) Add reconciliation safety check: when creating a receipt, if a receipt already exists in NetSuite with same `charge.id` or `invoice.id`, skip and emit metric `receipt.duplicate.skipped`.
3) Retroactive script to find duplicate receipts where `charge.id` matches and void the later receipt. Will include audit trail linking to Stripe event ids.
leah_ops: Can you prepare a dry-run CSV of duplicates and output from the void script? We need fields: net_suite_receipt_id, stripe_charge_id, invoice_id, amount, created_at, created_by_event.
sam: Running detection dry-run now: command I used:

```
python tools/find_duplicate_receipts.py --input-query "charge_id:ch_3Kxyz OR created_at:2026-03-22" --dry-run --output /tmp/dup_receipts_2265432100.csv
```
Dry-run result: 27 rows, total duplicate amount $12,450. CSV uploaded to /secure-drive/finance/dup_receipts_2265432100.csv
billing-bot: Reconciliation job #daily-recon flagged duplicates: /jobs/3344. 27 dup receipts found. Alert sent to #finance.
max_fin: Finance approves automated void for duplicates where amount <= $2,000 and where we can attach Stripe event ids. For larger ones, escalate to manual review. Please run voids in a paused window to avoid interfering with month-end close.
sam: I'll open PR with code changes and a canary plan: https://internal/git/receipts-consumer/pull/612 - change summary: prefer canonical keys (invoice.id/charge.id) for idempotency; add metric and skip logic; include safe-void script `scripts/void_duplicate_receipts.py` with `--dry-run` flag.
leah_ops: Please also ensure that we log the Stripe event ids that triggered the original and duplicate receipts. We'll need them for audit notes on the reversed receipts.
sam: Void script dry-run command:

```
python scripts/void_duplicate_receipts.py --csv /secure-drive/finance/dup_receipts_2265432100.csv --dry-run --out /tmp/void_plan_2265432100.json
```
Observed log snippet on staging after applying skip logic: `INFO receipts - skipping duplicate new_receipt_request for charge ch_3Kxyz (existing receipt ns_rcpt_9876)`
billing-bot: Void job scheduled (after finance approve window) job_id=55678. ETA 18m.
max_fin: Approved. Proceed with automated voids for approved set. Ensure we capture reversal journal ids.
sam: Void job complete. Voided 27 duplicate receipts. Void journal refs uploaded: /secure-drive/finance/void_journals_2265432100.csv. Total voided amount $12,450. Instrumented `receipt.duplicate.voided` metric.
leah_ops: Re-ran daily-recon after voids: no duplicate receipts remain for those charge ids. Nightly totals reconciled.
zoe_fin: Thanks team. Filing FIN-514 for RCA: cause = using payment_intent.id as idempotency key during SCA flows; fix = prefer charge/invoice ids, add skip logic, add detection alert. Please include rollout notes and a follow-up to verify paging thresholds for these metrics.
sam: Merged PR and will monitor `receipt.duplicate.skipped` metric for 48h. If rate > 1/min or total amount > $5k in 1h, page ops.
leah_ops: Closing loop once dashboard shows zero duplicates. Thanks :thumbsup:
